20261121-physics-m1-1.title: (Mukati me elastic limit)
20261121-physics-m1-1.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye (Mukati me elastic limit) kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261121-physics-m1-1.material: Spring yakasungirirwa chizito che 2 N ikareba 3 cm kupfuura kureba kwayo kwekutanga. Spring iyi ichareba marii cm kana yasungirirwa chizito che 6 N? (Mukati me elastic limit)
20261121-physics-m1-1.s.s1.prompt: Spring yakasungirirwa chizito che 2 N ikareba 3 cm kupfuura kureba kwayo kwekutanga. Spring iyi ichareba marii cm kana yasungirirwa chizito che 6 N? (Mukati me elastic limit)
20261121-physics-m1-1.s.s1.explain: Maererano ne Hooke's law, mukati me elastic limit, kureba kwakatambanuka kunoenderana nesimba (huremu) rakaiswa. Simba rakawedzera katatu, saka kureba kwakatambanuka ndi $3\text{ cm} \times 3 = 9\text{ cm}$.

20261122-physics-m1-1.s.s1.prompt: [Kuverenga kwepamusoro] Chidimbu chemuti chine volume ye 500 cm³ uye mass ye 400 g chakaiswa kuyangarara mumvura (density 1.0 g/cm³). Kana chamira, volume yenzvimbo yakanyudzwa mumvura i marii cm³?

20261122-physics-m1-2.goal: Shandisa misimboti ye Bhora resimbi rinorema 10 N mumhepo kugadzirisa dambudziko reongororo.
20261122-physics-m1-2.material: Bhora resimbi rinorema 10 N mumhepo, rakanyudzwa zvizere mumvura, uye scale ye spring yakaverenga 8 N. Buoyant force inowanwa nebhora resimbi mumvura i yakaenzana nei?
20261122-physics-m1-2.s.s1.prompt: Bhora resimbi rinorema 10 N mumhepo, rakanyudzwa zvizere mumvura, uye scale ye spring yakaverenga 8 N. Buoyant force inowanwa nebhora resimbi mumvura i yakaenzana nei?

20261122-physics-m2-1.material: [Kuongorora circuit yepamusoro] Resistor ye 6 Ω neye 3 Ω zvakabatanidzwa mu parallel, ndokubatanidzwa ku power supply ye 12 V. Total current inofamba mu circuit yose i yakaenzana nei?
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.prompt: [Kuongorora circuit yepamusoro] Resistor ye 6 Ω neye 3 Ω zvakabatanidzwa mu parallel, ndokubatanidzwa ku power supply ye 12 V. Total current inofamba mu circuit yose i yakaenzana nei?
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.explain: Combined resistance yeparallel ndeye $\frac{1}{R_p} = \frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{2} \implies R_p = 2\,\Omega$. Total current i $I = \frac{12\text{ V}}{2\,\Omega} = 6\text{ A}$.
